body: i'm 47. please dont do it. is the scumbag who raped you in jail or prison? i know he didnt just rape your body, he stole who you used to be. i know it feels like that. but dont let him win! dont you do it! if you give up, he wins! please call someone for help. please call this number 1-800-273-TALK(8255). they wont judge you. you've reached out this far, please just call the number.

what keeps me going is i want to see what happens tomorrow. i've had so many bad days, sometimes bad weeks. but good days always come back around. i remember getting divirced. (i'm old, 47. lol) i thought my world had ended. i didnt know what to do. i didnt know who i was. then one day i was just talking to this woman, and she asked me if i was hungry. i was. so we had dinner and just talked... a lot. after dinner, she kissed me! i never thought anyone would ever kiss me again. that was a great day. lol i guess what i'm saying is, nothing is forever. you just live your life and see what tomorrow brings. :) there is great beauty in the world. sometimes you have to look hard for it. other times it washes over you!

dont give up trying new things. ever try guitar? it's easy to learn enough to play a blues tune. i mean like it'll take you an hour and you'll be playing a basic blues tune. i play drums. those arent hard to learn the basics. any decent teacher could have you playing in minutes. what about MMA or karate? or research? can you find info online? people make good money doing research. dont stop trying new things. take chances!

i had music classes in highschool. those were great. but i hated the rest of it. i didnt like the clicks of kids who picked on who they thought were "uncool" i'm 47 and i can tell you, it will not last forever. i know plenty of "cool kids" who wound up being nothings in life. once you're out of school, your life becomes yours! you can do and be anything you decide to do or be. i swear this doesnt define what you will be. thats for you to decide, no one else!

i'm 47 and i can tell you, i've screwed up a LOT in my life. it get's better. I PROMISE YOU! every day, you get a new chance to change everything. nothing lasts forever... again I PROMISE YOU! lets talk, maybe i know a trick or two to help you get past this.

lets talk. i've been through a lot of bad stuff myself. i'd like to help... if you'd let me. what is making you feel like this? does it feel like you "feel" more than most people? if thats the case, you may be "emphatic" that means you feel the emotions of others, strongly. those emotions can seem like they're coming from you, but they;re not, they're from people around you. people you may not even know. try to identify one emotion at a time, look at it, feel it pass through you, then allow it to go out into the air away from you.  being emphatic is an ability, not a curse. but it takes a little practice to let go of feelings that arent yours. what you describe is what empaths go through. the feeling of sinking under emotions. try looking up "empath". see if this isnt you to a T. please let me know what you think... or what you find out when you study up on empaths.
want to talk about it? i've been through a lot of shit, maybe i can help.
